description: Explicit user action only. Deletes a run and cascades to every run-keyed table via ON DELETE CASCADE foreign keys.
signature: def delete_run(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str) -> None
docstring:
Delete a run and all of its data.

Args:
    conn: An open connection with foreign_keys=ON (guaranteed by get_connection).
    run_id: The run to delete.

Returns:
    None.

Note:
    A no-op, not an error, when run_id does not exist -- deletion is idempotent from the caller's perspective (ARCHITECTURE.md retention policy: 'Deletion is an explicit user action that cascades across all run-keyed tables').
postconditions: After a successful call, get_run(conn, run_id) is None
No rows referencing run_id remain in run_events, raw_games, games_enriched, game_tags or analysis_results
Calling delete_run again on the same (now-absent) run_id is a no-op, not an error

edge_cases.input: run_id is referenced as another run's parent_run_id
edge_cases.expected_behavior: the child run's parent_run_id becomes dangling; since parent_run_id has no ON DELETE action specified in the schema, this is either left as-is (orphaned reference, acceptable since parent_run_id is reserved/unused in v1) or must set NULL -- flagged as an open question below since 01_storage.module_spec.json's schema string does not specify ON DELETE behavior for runs.parent_run_id

edge_cases.input: Deleting a run that is currently 'running' (mid-pipeline)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: storage performs the deletion unconditionally; preventing deletion of an in-flight run is orchestration's/ui's responsibility, not storage's

unit_tests.name: test_delete_run_cascades_to_all_tables
unit_tests.description: A fully populated synthetic run (rows in all five child tables) is fully removed after delete_run.
unit_tests.expected: zero rows remain in run_events, raw_games, games_enriched, game_tags, analysis_results for that run_id

unit_tests.name: test_delete_unknown_run_is_noop
unit_tests.description: Deleting a nonexistent run_id does not raise.

open_questions: 01_storage.module_spec.json's `runs` table string does not specify ON DELETE behavior for the self-referential parent_run_id foreign key. Needs an explicit decision (SET NULL vs. RESTRICT vs. leave unspecified/default RESTRICT) before delete_run's contract for a run that is someone else's parent is fully determined; currently assumed low-impact since parent_run_id is unused (always NULL) in v1.
